t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Press the buttons quickly, the person previous recommended picking the taller gnomes as they collected more but in this persons experience they found the shorter ones were more effective.

vb_textbox.text: Always keep your fingers on the keys required for the game so that you don't miss a round. The previous note suggested that shorter gnomes collected more points however I found the pattern not to be so simple. In order to even my chances I took it in turns to pick a taller then smaller, it's worth trying to pick up a pattern if you can.
